kultivator.screen.help.tugas.title: Sect Duties and the Storehouse
kultivator.screen.help.tugas: On the Duties tablet of the Sect Hall, give a disciple near the stele a duty. It walks to a post 5 blocks from the stele and works there: Carry Water (XP, a sturdier body, PK and Tempering Points), the Hundred Medicine Garden (spirit ingredients), the Ovens (Spirit Meals) or the Spirit Tail Chicken Farm (feathers; it needs 4 chickens near the stele). No block or crop is touched. The goods go to the 27-slot Sect Storehouse: click a slot on the tablet to take it out. Foundation Herbs are refined there too: 3 herbs make one Foundation Establishment Pill. Hall levels 3, 6 and 9 add posts.
kultivator.screen.help.misi.title: Expeditions, Story Missions, Envoys and the Forbidden Ground
kultivator.screen.help.misi: The Missions tablet shows today's Expedition board (new at sunrise). Send 1-3 disciples: they leave the world and come back when the time is up, even while you are offline. Success depends on their strength against the tier; a failed team returns hurt, but nobody dies. Successful expeditions give PK, a share of a breakthrough bar, renown and loot for the storehouse. Outer disciples lead tiers 1-2, Inner up to 5, Core every tier. Beside the expeditions are the Story Missions (card Sect › Living Sect › Story Missions): a team of 1-4 disciples leaves for 1-3 world days with the stance you choose (Peaceful, Firm or Cunning), the outcome is rolled in three stages that branch into a story, nobody dies, and the team walks back in through the gate with a Report Scroll, sometimes with candidates or treasure too. Every 5 days an envoy can bring back 1-3 talented youths as candidates. Every few weeks at hall level 2+ the wind seal of the Blood-Colored Forbidden Ground weakens for a day: up to 3 Qi Refining disciples may go in for Foundation Herbs. Secret Realms can yield Kunpeng bone pieces; six different ones teach a Core disciple the Kunpeng Wings.
kultivator.screen.help.turnamen.title: Tournaments and the Hundred Dynasties War
kultivator.screen.help.turnamen: Every week at noon (or with Start Now on the Arena tablet) up to 8 of your Outer+ disciples fight a single-elimination bracket in the Lei Tai ring of the sect arena; you must be within 32 blocks and 3 disciples must be in the territory. Every bout is a 90-second Sword Duel (the final 120 seconds, with an opening film) that stops at 10%% health; an empty-handed disciple is lent a wooden training sword. If the Sword Duel is off on the server, the old bout applies: it ends at 10%% health, after 60 seconds or when a fighter stays out of the ring. Nobody dies. The tournament also has seasons and an Elo rating per disciple, spectators on the stands and guests from NPC sects (topic Sect Tournament). Every third competition is an Elite Tournament with rival champions, and afterwards the ghostly Primordial Ark floats over the hall for a day for its top three. On every 4th recruitment day at hall level 3+, eight youths of a hundred dynasties arrive: start their war on the Candidates or Arena tablet, and the champion may join free as an Outer disciple.
kultivator.screen.help.alam_hampa.title: Void God Realm, Blazing Sky Tower and the Promotion Trial
kultivator.screen.help.alam_hampa: An Inner+ disciple can sit at the stele and climb the endless Void God Realm in spirit: every floor is a duel with a phantom, up to 5 floors a day. First clears give a share of a bar; floor 50 is the Sacred Border. A loss only leaves a 5-minute Soul Wound. Tower rooms are built by you: a lit Soul Campfire on Crying Obsidian within 32 blocks of the stele (up to 7, the highest is floor 1). A disciple training on floor n meditates much faster but pays n PK per minute, and heart-fire surges test its comprehension. The Special Promotion Training (Outer to Inner, started from the Ranks tablet) means holding the stele for 60 seconds against three waves without your help.
